description: Take one of your orders off the book, by the kind and id orders_list_mine returned: a listing is archived, an intent withdrawn while its bid window runs, a token order's unfilled remainder cancelled. Cancelling a cancelled order returns it unchanged.

id.description: The order's id, as orders_list_mine returned it.

kind.description: The order's kind, as orders_list_mine returned it: listing, intent or token_order.

name: orders_cancel
title: Orders cancel
